# companion-status-v1 contract vectors.
#
# Each case is a `line:` the Companion's writer (CompanionStatus.java) emits
# for the inputs CompanionStatusTest.java gives it, and an `expect:` of what
# the host parser (packages/adapters/src/transports/companion-status.js)
# decodes from that line. Both sides read this file, so a writer change that
# the reader does not follow -- or the reverse -- fails a test on the side
# that drifted. snapshotNs is a string in `expect` because JSON has no bigint.
#
# Endpoint vectors (`endpoint:` + `endpoint-expect:`) hold the handshake file
# (companion-endpoint-v1) as one line with `\n` separators.

case: idle
